summary: Curated pseudonymized session handoff for data accuracy assessment
description: Issue summary: The Data Science team needs a tightly scoped, pseudonymized sample of production session records to validate a new customer-identifier hashing pipeline and measure data accuracy across join keys. Impact: Without representative samples we cannot validate the HMAC-based key-join and may delay a billing-reconciliation pilot with a partner. Justification: This is an internal-only validation — no full plaintext customer identifiers requested. Data minimization: Request asks for up to 1,200 sessions across three traffic slices (payment, authentication, inference-failures) with PII fields replaced by one-way HMAC and timestamp fuzzing (+/- 2 minutes). Scope & retention: Extract will be ephemeral (S3 temp bucket with 7-day TTL), stored with KMS encryption and two-person access controls. Steps to reproduce / deliverable: 1) Define query: session_start, session_id, hashed_customer_id (HMAC-SHA256 with per-request salt), route, model_version, tokens_in, tokens_out, error_flag, nearest_minute_timestamp. 2) Engineering run to produce CSV and checksum. 3) Privacy review and QA check. 4) Hand off to Data Science in a restricted S3 path with audit log. Access duration requested: 7 days. Controls requested: two-person approval to decrypt salts, ephemeral KMS key usage, access logging enabled, and no download ACLs for collaborators outside verified DS group. Requester: Jonah Emmett (Data Science). Approvals required: Privacy, Security, Support-ops, and Infra.
steps_to_execute: 1) Support-ops to schedule extraction job on prod telemetry fleet (query vetted by privacy). 2) Infra to provision temp S3 path with KMS CMK (rotation policy: single-use). 3) Privacy to verify HMAC salt handling and fuzzing. 4) Run extraction in canary slice first (50 sessions), review sample with privacy. 5) If sample passes, run full extract (1,200 sessions). 6) Grant Jonah Emmett read-only access and enable CloudTrail + S3 server access logs. 7) Revoke access and delete objects after 7 days.

investigation_notes: Privacy validated HMAC-SHA256 with per-extract salt; recommended storing salt only in ephemeral KMS-accessed secret and not in logs. Engineering ensured query does not emit raw_email or raw_customer_id. Canary uncovered timestamp clustering; decided to keep +/-2 minute fuzzing but add a 5% random-minute offset to reduce clustering artifacts. DS confirmed sample size adequate for statistical validation.
risk_assessment: Residual risk: low-medium. Pseudonymization reduces reidentification risk but not zero. Controls (single-use salt, CMK encryption, two-person control) mitigate operational and compliance exposure. No external sharing allowed. Recommended post-handoff audit log review within 10 days.
